about_the_game:
Ayrton Idle is an Auto-Battler Idler RPG — a game by Ayrton, for Ayrton... and now, for you too.

Inspired by the golden age of Flash games, Ayrton Idle is built to run in the background or alongside your daily tasks. 

I wanted the Mobile Idle experience but without the MTX, so I originally made this game to entertain myself while I worked.— now it’s here to keep you busy while you’re busy.

Key Features:

  • Auto-Battles – combat plays out while you focus elsewhere.

  • Dungeons – tackle preset sequences of fights for rewards.

  • Caves – procedurally generated tile-based maps with battles and hidden chests.

  • 8 Equipment Slots – Head, Body, Hand, Legs, Main Hand, Off Hand, Ring, Neck.

  • Upgradeable Gear – boost your item's stats over time.

  • Mining & Smelting – gather and refine resources.

  • Fishing – relax and catch something valuable.

  • Quest System – complete tasks and earn progress.

Looking for a simple, satisfying idle experience?

You’re in the right place.

content_descriptors.notes: I am a one-man team so please beware the moderation is lacking for the online chat. You can avoid using it altogether.
